name: Sokkou Hikaku Jirai Circle
original_name: 速攻非核地雷サークル
source:
Strategy to lay landmines and destroy enemy robots. 
Main character is a mechanic that assists heroines who manage robots equipped with firearms.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-february-2001-tasogare.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
布设地雷并摧毁敌方机器人的战略游戏。
主人公是一名机械师，负责协助驾驶武装机器人的女主角们。
